# Secret Seattle

> > Secret Seattle is a local guide to Seattle's hidden gems, food scene, cultural events, and neighborhood discoveries across Capitol Hill, Pike Place Market, Fremont, and beyond.

Secret Seattle curates insider recommendations for Seattle residents and visitors, covering everything from the city's renowned coffee culture and innovative restaurants to local events, infrastructure updates, and unique attractions that define the Pacific Northwest's largest city.

## Key Topics

- Seattle neighborhoods (Capitol Hill, Fremont, Pioneer Square, SLU)
- Coffee culture & espresso pioneers
- Pike Place Market
- Local restaurants & food scene
- Seattle events & exhibitions
- Space Needle & iconic landmarks
- West Seattle Bridge updates
- Washington State policy & news
- Latte art & specialty cafes
- Chihuly Garden and Glass
- Monorail Espresso
- Espresso Vivace
- David Schomer
- Neighborhood cafe guides
- Art & cultural attractions

## Seattle Food & Coffee Culture

- [The 10 Best Coffee Shops In Seattle According To Locals](https://secretseattle.co/coffee-shops-seattle): Local favorites: Monorail Espresso, Espresso Vivace & top Capitol Hill cafes
- [8 Sweet Dessert Spots You Can Find In Pike Place Market](https://secretseattle.co/dessert-pike-place-market): Pike Place Market desserts: Indi Chocolate, Shugs Soda Fountain & more
- [Newly-Opened Tio Baby's Serves Up Crunchy, Cheesy Comfort Food](https://secretseattle.co/tio-babys): Will Gordon's new Wallingford comfort food spot opens late-night
- [Rasai In Seattle Debuts A New Tasting Menu Of Creatively-Presented Indian Food](https://secretseattle.co/rasai-seattle): Fremont's Rasai launches creative Indian tasting menu with artistic plating

## Seattle Attractions & Local Experiences

- [The Top 7 Unique Things Seattle Has That Other Cities Don't](https://secretseattle.co/unique-things-seattle): Only-in-Seattle features: Starbucks origins, Beecher's cheese & local gems
- [Get Crafty At The Works Seattle This Summer](https://secretseattle.co/the-works-seattle): Kellie Phelan's Pioneer Square DIY workshop studio offers hands-on classes
- [Celebrate Mother's Day With An Unforgettable Picnic At Seattle Center](https://secretseattle.co/mothers-day-picnic-seattle-center): Mother's Day picnic spots near Space Needle & International Fountain
- [There Is A Newly Orphaned Brown Bear Cub At Woodland Park Zoo](https://secretseattle.co/orphaned-brown-bear-cub-at-woodland-park-zoo): Alaska rescue bear cub Juniper arrives at Woodland Park Zoo

## Arts & Cultural Events

- [This Breathtaking Life-Size Sistine Chapel Exhibition Is Heading To Seattle](https://secretseattle.co/sistine-chapel-exhibition): Michelangelo's Sistine Chapel exhibition coming to The Bravern
- [Seattle's Asian Art Museum Finally Reopening In May](https://secretseattle.co/seattle-asian-art-museum-reopening): SAM's Volunteer Park museum reopens with Boundless & Be/longing exhibits
- [Don't Miss This Mini Golf Pop-Up At The Paramount Theater This Weekend](https://secretseattle.co/mini-golf-paramount-theater): Flatstick Pub hosts mini golf pop-up at Paramount Theater with STG

## Seattle News & Infrastructure

- [The West Seattle Bridge Finally Has An Official Reopening Date](https://secretseattle.co/west-seattle-bridge-reopening): SDOT announces official West Seattle Bridge reopening date after repairs
- [Seattle Has The Worst Air Quality In The World This Week](https://secretseattle.co/seattle-worst-air-quality): Bolt Creek Fire smoke gives Seattle world's worst air quality ranking
- [Washington State To Ban Sales Of Gasoline Cars](https://secretseattle.co/washington-state-banning-gas-cars): Gov. Inslee's 2035 gas car ban follows California's zero-emissions policy
- [Children 12 And Older Can Now Get Vaccinated Against COVID-19 In Washington State](https://secretseattle.co/children-12-older-vaccinated-washington-state): Pfizer COVID-19 vaccine approved for ages 12+ by FDA and CDC

## Nature & Sky Events

- [Here's How To Watch The Perseid Meteor Shower In Seattle](https://secretseattle.co/perseid-meteor-shower-seattle): Perseid meteor shower viewing guide for Seattle parks in August 2022
- [The Orionid Meteor Shower Will Peak This Week](https://secretseattle.co/orionid-meteor-shower-peak): Halley's Comet debris creates Orionid meteor shower peak over Seattle
